name: PFBT
summary: Tropane derivative substance that is suggested to have around ~30% the potency of cocaine as a stimulant, while also having properties of a local anasthetic.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 3β-(p-Fluorobenzoyloxy)tropane, (8-Methyl-8-azabicyclo[3.2.1]oct-3-yl 4-fluorobenzoic acid ester, 4-fluorotropacocaine, 3-Pseudotropyl-4-fluorobenzoate, 3-pseudotropyl-4-fluorobenzoate, pFBT) is a tropane derivative drug which acts as a local anaesthetic, having around 30% the stimulant potency of cocaine but around the same potency as a local anaesthetic.

uses.text: It has been investigated as a potential radiolabelled agent for studying receptor binding, but was not adopted for this application.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is reported to be weaker than cocaine. Stimulants of this kind can raise heart rate and blood pressure, and local anaesthetics can disturb the heart's rhythm.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。據報告它的作用比古柯鹼弱。這類興奮劑可能使心跳與血壓上升，而局部麻醉劑則可能擾亂心臟節律。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。据报告它的作用比古柯碱弱。这类兴奋剂可能使心跳与血压上升，而局部麻醉剂则可能扰乱心脏节律。

fact.en: It is a tropane, the family of cocaine and atropine, named after atropine's source, the deadly nightshade Atropa belladonna.
fact.zh: 它屬於托烷類，與古柯鹼和阿托平同一家族；這個名稱源自阿托平的來源植物顛茄（Atropa belladonna）。
fact.zhHans: 它属于托烷类，与古柯碱和阿托平同一家族；这个名称源自阿托平的来源植物颠茄（Atropa belladonna）。
